scientific_integrity: The explicit weighted-arch decomposition proves exact coefficient counts. Finite exact enumeration corroborates the proof but cannot certify the infinite statement. Prior arch characterization is credited. Priority remains subject to further external examination.
scientific_limitations: Binary words with exactly k copies of a and k+s of b, k>=1,s>=0; asymptotic requires s fixed. General compositions and growth of s are not determined.
title: Exact Parikh-matrix distribution of maximally universal binary words at minimum letter support
